case.title: 500 failed login attempts detected on srv-web-01 from single source in 8 minutes
case.desc: Automated dictionary attack against web server authentication portal targeting 240 user accounts.

organization.name: Kumaraguru College of Technology
organization.address: Athipalayam Road, Chinnavedampatti, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu 641049
organization.dpo_title: Data Protection Officer & Head of IT

steps.title: Block the attacking source
steps.notes: Attacking IP blocked immediately at host and perimeter firewall.

steps.title: Protect targeted accounts
steps.notes: Temporarily locked 240 targeted user accounts to halt authentication attempts.

steps.title: Review authentication logs
steps.notes: Reviewed auth logs; confirmed no logins succeeded prior to firewall block.

steps.title: Reset credentials and enforce lockout policy
steps.notes: Mandatory password reset dispatched and Fail2ban threshold lowered.

recommendations: Enforce rate-limiting and captcha on web portal login endpoints.
Implement fail2ban with maxretry=5 and bantime=3600.
Require MFA for all staff remote logins.
